However , in terms of planning and execution , the two @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ the Baghdadi operation , most technical intelligence -- TECHINT -- had failed to provide any actionable information and led to a number of false starts , according to a senior US military source who declined to be named due to the sensitivity of the subject . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;But in the case of Neptune Spear , the codename given to the operation to kill bin Laden , it was crucial . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Months before the operation to kill Bin Laden was approved , US intelligence chanced upon the whereabouts of the Al-Qaeda chief 's courier , who claimed Bin Laden was hiding out in a compound in Abbottabad , Pakistan . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Through TECHINT , the US determined there was a 60% likelihood that Bin Laden was indeed in the Abbottabad compound -- &lt;span class= " s1 " &gt; giving then-President Obama acceptable odds to justify greenlighting the raid . &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the case of Bin Laden , Washington also had a major geopolitical problem to contend with . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Unlike in Idlib , where Al Qaeda-linked militants hold sway over a chaotic territory out of government control , but where @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ and NATO ally Turkey , Pakistan is a sovereign state and a nuclear weapons power . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Inserting US special forces into Abbottabad from Afghanistan , knowing that Pakistani Air Force F-16 jets could easily take them down while they were still in the air , was considerably more complex . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The Obama administration had to wrangle over when it would inform the Pakistani authorities that an operation had been launched to take out bin Laden . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Pakistan would later claim that their best radars were usually aimed against a possible intrusion by Indian fighter jets coming in from the east . &lt;p&gt;On March 12 , 2019 , Dennis Muilenburg phoned US President Donald Trump for support after European and Chinese regulators grounded the Boeing 737 MAX following an Ethiopian Airlines crash that killed 157 people . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;When Muilenburg hung up , the Boeing chief executive @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ But the next day , Trump announced that Boeing&amp;#8217 ; s top-selling plane was &amp;#8220 ; grounded effective immediately . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; **25;56763;TOOLONG ; s entire global fleet of almost 400 MAX planes has stayed out of service ever since , plunging the 103-year-old aerospace giant into the biggest crisis of its history . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The situation has raised questions about Boeing&amp;#8217 ; s commitment to safety and corporate culture while also tarnishing the company&amp;#8217 ; s image as it continues to compete with archrival Airbus . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The crisis has cost Boeing billions of dollars and spawned numerous investigations by US authorities , as well as a lawsuits from victims&amp;#8217 ; families . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;Blaming the pilots&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;The crisis actually began months earlier on October 29 , 2018 , when a MAX operated by Indonesian carrier Lion Air plunged into the Java Sea . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&amp;#8220 ; Boeing blamed the pilots immediately in Lion Air , and then bungled the response thereafter , &amp;#8221 ; said Scott Hamilton of Leeham News , an aviation publication . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&amp;#8220 ; Boeing&amp;#8217 ; s stubborn resistance to admit its mistakes @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ operation of 737 MAX planes -- are turning this into a disaster for the company and its customers , &amp;#8221 ; said Jim Hall , former chairman of the US National Transportation Safety Board ( NTSB ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Indonesian investigators last week attributed the crash to nine factors , including inadequate pilot training and a poorly designed flight handling system known as the Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System ( MCAS ) that it said wasn&amp;#8217 ; t properly certified by US regulators. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&amp;#8220 ; These items were connected to each other . If one of them was not occurring on that day , the accident may not have happened , &amp;#8221 ; said Nurcahyo Utomo , an investigator with Indonesia&amp;#8217 ; s National Transportation Safety Committee . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;MCAS under focus&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;If the investigation showed Lion Air&amp;#8217 ; s pilots to be young and untested , it also revealed them to be in the dark about the MCAS , which was not mentioned in Boeing&amp;#8217 ; s flight manual . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The system has also been implicated in the Ethiopian Airlines crash . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The MCAS was developed specifically @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ caused by the plane&amp;#8217 ; s heavier engines . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The system was activated shortly after takeoff in both flights based on an incorrect sensor reading . The error stemmed from an angle of attack sensor that was approved for service by Xtra Aerospace , a Florida company that had its repair station certificate revoked by the FAA last week . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The pilots in the two crashes were unable to regain control of the planes from MCAS , in part because the system was designed with no redundancy to that single sensor . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;A report last month from the NTSB said Boeing and the FAA misjudged how pilots would respond to multiple alerts and alarms as they encountered trouble when flying the 737 MAX. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Another report earlier this month from a panel of global regulators concluded the FAA lacked the manpower and expertise to evaluate the MCAS. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;A few days after the Lion Air crash , the FAA sent a directive to MAX operators about the risk of a faulty angle of attack sensor while Boeing developed an upgrade to the MCAS. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;However , Boeing @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ the Ethiopian Airlines crash five months later . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;Competing with Airbus&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;Since the accident , Boeing&amp;#8217 ; s conduct during the development of the MAX has come under scrutiny , particularly on the question of whether it cut corners to launch the MAX quickly . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the spring of 2011 , American Airlines , which had previously bought exclusively from Boeing , warned the US company that it was considering a large order with Airbus for the A320neo , a fuel-efficient version of a model that competed directly with the 737. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Boeing was told it must quickly come up with a rival to match the A320neo to avoid completely losing the order , a source told AFP. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Recognizing that launching an entirely new model would take years , Boeing instead opted to update the 737 , a line first launched in 1968 and which had been last modernized in 1997. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;To speed the process , Boeing wanted &amp;#8220 ; the minimum change to reduce costs and get it done quickly , &amp;#8221 ; former Boeing engineer Rick Ludtke , who worked on the MAX cockpit @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ in three Boeing employees reported feeling &amp;#8220 ; potential undue pressure&amp;#8221 ; from managers during the period when the MAX was developed , according to an internal survey reviewed by AFP. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Boeing added the MCAS to boost handling of the MAX , which had bigger engines than earlier 737 versions , even as other parts such as the fuselage and the landing gear were identical to older models . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Recall this quote from the top of the story : &amp;#8220 ; The final version was an example of trial-and-error and compromise , rather than design and production optimization , &amp;#8221 ; said an industrial source . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;New training unnecessary&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;In its promotional materials , Boeing assured airlines that pilots familiar with prior 737 models required no significant additional training to fly the MAX , according to material described to AFP by congressional staff . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;That purported similarity of the MAX to earlier versions also speeded the regulatory process . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Boeing was so confident of its stance that it agreed to give Southwest Airline a rebate of $1 million per-plane if simulator training was needed , @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ tests , Boeing pilot Mark Forkner maintained to aviation regulators that the MCAS would activate only in rare cases and would not require supplementary training . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;But just before the certification , Forkner told a colleague that the MCAS was operating unexpectedly during a simulator test , according to text messages released by a congressional committee . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&amp;#8220 ; So I basically lied to the regulators ( unknowingly ) , &amp;#8221 ; Forkner said in the text message . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The FAA , which allowed Boeing to leave the MCAS out of flight manuals , has itself come under sharp criticism over its certification of the MAX , particularly its handling of a program that delegated elements of the certification to Boeing . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;Cloudy future&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;While Boeing has acknowledged mistakes in its communication with regulators , it has pushed back against suggestions that the MAX suffered from design flaws . &lt;/p&gt; a Boeing spokesman said @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ by about 20 percent as it works to win recertification of the plane . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Boeing has submitted to the FAA documentation on the upgrade to the MCAS , which includes two angle-of-attack readings and the ability for pilots to shut down the MCAS if there is a disagreement between the sensors . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;But uncertainty continues to hang over the MAX , including whether Boeing will meet its target date to win regulatory approval this year . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;One outstanding question is whether pilots will be required to undergo simulator testing of the new system , a step favored by European and Canadian regulators that the FAA has said it believes is not necessary . &lt;/p&gt; Photo : Andrew Salmon/Asia **39;57036;TOOLONG **28;57077;TOOLONG **30;57107;TOOLONG &lt;p&gt;In the bright , upbeat South Korea that is known worldwide today for K-pop and cosmetics , Samsung gadgets and Hyundai cars , it is easy to forget -- or not even know -- that the country had a surprisingly dark past not so long ago . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Following the 1950-53 Korean War , the devastated and poverty-wracked nation trod a path to industrial development under a brace of generals who seized power in coups . Park Chung-hee and Chun Do-hwan , between them , held power from 1961-1987. &lt;/p&gt; @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ or rule of law , Seoul created a national infrastructure , while an export-focused industrial sector rose from the paddy fields . As the country urbanized and industrialized , " economic warriors " in grim plants labored heroic hours to win South Korea its status as a " tiger economy . " &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;But while Korea enriched itself economically , political development remained stunted . By the late 1970s , a bourgeoise was emerging . In this newly prosperous neo-Confucian society , a university education was highly prized . It was from among the ranks of students that activists began agitating for change , for democratic rights and freedoms . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In response , Seoul 's authoritarian governments -- which faced legitimate espionage threats from North Korea -- engineered a machinery of repression . A vast network of informants , divisions of conscripted riot police and secretive undercover police units came into being . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In 1976 , a key element of this shadowy infrastructure rose in central Seoul 's Namyeong Dong , a district that is today just two subway stops south of City Hall . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;figure id= @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ " wp-caption alignnone " &gt;&lt;img class= " size-full wp-image-391573 " src= " https : **34;57139;TOOLONG ... alt= " " width= " 1632 " height= " 1224 " srcset= " https : **31;57175;TOOLONG ... 1632w , https : **39;57208;TOOLONG ... 768w , https : **39;57249;TOOLONG ... 1568w " sizes= " ( max-width : 1632px ) 100vw , 1632px " /&gt;&lt;figcaption class= " wp-caption-text " &gt;What was once the most feared location in Seoul is now set in a vibrant , lively student neighborhood . " &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;But that was just the public face . They are direct samples of matter from outside the solar system . Physicists are @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ be accelerated to ultra-high energies . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Now scientists have found most cosmic rays are atomic nuclei . All the natural elements in the periodic table are present in cosmic rays . About 90% of them are the nuclei of hydrogen ( protons ) ; about 9% are helium nuclei ( alpha particles ) ; and the other heavier elements , electrons , gamma rays , neutrinos and antimatter particles make up the other 1%. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Since most cosmic rays are charged , their paths through space are deflected by magnetic fields . On their journey to Earth , the magnetic fields of the galaxy , the solar system , and the earth scramble their flight paths so much that we can no longer know exactly where they came from . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Many countries have invested heavily in the study of cosmic rays . China , the United States , Russia , Japan , Germany and other countries have established observation stations . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;figure id= " attachment390893 " style= " width : 553px " class= " wp-caption aligncenter " &gt;&lt;img class= " wp-image-390893 size-full " src= " https : @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ " 372 " /&gt;&lt;figcaption class= " wp-caption-text " &gt;Construction of the first half of the observation station , known as Large High-Altitude Air Shower Observatory ( LHAASO ) , is due to be finished at the end of this year , and the whole project completed at the end of 2020 . According to the report , the Bull supergun would have a range of 1,000 kilometers ( 621 miles ) and would fire a type of ammunition @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ a device that centers a munition in the barrel of a gun , but when the gun is fired the sabot is discharged and falls away . A key purpose is to allow the projectile to be aerodynamically designed , typically including fin stabilization so as to increase the accuracy of the round . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;There are two different approaches to the design of a supergun . The first , and oldest is to sequentially charge the projectile as it traverses the barrel of the gun tube . The idea is by adding force to a projectile already accelerating in a gun tube , the projectile would gain speed and therefore range . The earliest approach was to set charges along the barrel that would fire off at 45-degree angles to the accelerating shell , increasing its velocity . The US inventor Azel Storrs Lyman was &lt;a href= " https : **33;77393;TOOLONG ... a patent&lt;/a&gt; for such a gun system in 1857 ( &amp;#8216 ; Improvement in accelerating firearms&amp;#8217 ; ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;One of the problems in this approach is how to get the staggered additional charges to fire @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ ; t exact , the shell might actually slow down or even explode inside the barrel . A secondary issue is how to prevent tremendous wear and tear on the barrel caused by the exploding charges . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the V-3 the intent was to fire repeatedly and quickly at the target -- the city of London . The V-3 was not capable of pinpoint attack . It was mostly intended as a terror weapon , just like Allied carpet bombing -- including incendiary bombs -- dropped on German cities , the most notorious being Dresden . Before the atomic bomb in 1945 , the Allies also heavily bombed Japanese cities , including the devastating fire-bombing of Tokyo . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;There are three methods for setting off charges inside a gun barrel , sequentially and on time . One is mechanical , where the initial firing and sequential explosions are set off based on a fixed timing system . The second is electrically , which potentially offers a more efficient solution for accurate timing . And a third , perhaps the method the V-3 used , was to bleed off @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ tube . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The second general approach for a supergun is to use a rocket assist , with one or two stages , to extend the range of a supergun . The advantage of this approach is that it is more cost effective than a multi-stage rocket without a gun . The gun provides very rapid acceleration , much more quickly than a rocket launch . One of Bull&amp;#8217 ; s planned versions of the S-1000 would use a rocket as a second ( or even a third ) stage , allowing the gun to set the initial speed of the shot . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The Bull gun , like the V-3 , was not supposed to be particularly accurate , and because of its great size and barrel length , had to be mounted in a fixed site . That made physical aiming beyond what was built into the initial barrel positioning , impossible . Syrian Civil War is being fought with firearms from around the globe . While American and Russian weapons are currently the most common , Chinese guns are rapidly increasing their " market share " of the battlefield , National Interest reported . @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ China has taken a notionally neutral position on the war , Chinese arms ending up in the hands of rebels , IS , and regime forces . How are they getting there ? Do they hold any advantages over their Russian and American counterparts ? &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;Probably the most common Chinese weapon in the Middle East is the Type 56 rifle , a variant of the ubiquitous AK . Characterized by the full ring surrounding the front sight , the Type 56 was exported in great numbers to the Middle East during the 1970s and 1980s , arming both Iran and Iraq during the Iran-Iraq wars , the National Interest report said . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;This has caused it to pop up everywhere in the region . It 's been seen in the hands of Iraqi insurgents and forms the bulk of the Islamic State 's arsenal . Type 56 rifles are also common sights within the Free Syrian Army and the Syrian regime National Defense Force . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ from anywhere , with both old stock being widespread and Norinco still manufacturing the rifle for export . They are common on international arms markets and often bought up by nations looking to arm groups with some level of deniability. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;The W85 heavy machine gun is a more interesting case . In previous wars in the region , most common heavy machine guns used by insurgents were of Soviet design . However , in the Syrian Civil War the Chinese W85 has reached prominence , showing up in many photos and videos from all sides , the National Interest report said . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;figure id= " attachment390886 " style= " width : 1204px " class= " wp-caption alignnone " &gt;&lt;img class= " size-full wp-image-390886 " src= " https : **34;85092;TOOLONG ... alt= " " width= " 1204 " height= " 458 " srcset= " https : **31;85128;TOOLONG ... 1204w , https : **39;85161;TOOLONG ... 768w " sizes= " ( max-width : 1204px ) 100vw , 1204px " /&gt;&lt;figcaption class= " wp-caption-text " &gt;Another surprisingly common weapon is the Norinco CQ , @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ National Interest . **34;85202;TOOLONG &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;The W85 is a modernized version of the Soviet DshK heavy machine gun , using a new front sight gas block and changing the receiver to reduce weight and improve simplicity . The similarity to the older machine gun means that crews trained on the older Dshk have an easy time utilizing the W85 . The W85 is half the weight of the Dshk , making it far more mobile and faster to set up . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;They are used primarily in the anti-aircraft role against Syrian regime aircraft . Many examples seen in pictures feature a wide angle anti-aircraft optical sight , possibly indicative of new-production W85s . It 's speculated that money used to procure these weapons came from Gulf states who support rebel forces . Interestingly , the W85 has also been seen on a small unmanned ground vehicle produced by an Iraqi militia . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;Another surprisingly common weapon is the Norinco CQ , a Chinese copy of @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ gun markets in the Middle East at significantly lower prices than original M16s and M4s , making them a good choice for a rebel who wants to look more " tactical " than his peers . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;Where they are coming from is not certain . Iran is known to have purchased CQ rifles and produce it under license , but rifles similar to those seen in the Middle East have been seen and manufactured under license in Sudan , the National Interest report said . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;The Norinco NP-20 pistol has also been widely seen on gun markets in the region Malhama Tactical , a notorious jihadi " PMC " has been filmed training with the pistol , which is said to be the most common 9 millimeter pistol in some areas of Iraq and Syria despite the proliferation of Glocks and Iraqi Tariqs. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;Other Chinese arms have seen use in the conflict in smaller numbers , primarily heavy weapons like the&lt;/span&gt; QLZ-87 automatic @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ and M99 anti-material rifles . &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style= " font-weight : 400 ; " &gt;China 's neutral stance and large arms manufacturing capability have allowed it to produce arms for other parties to provide under deniable cover to their local proxies . AISLE , MIDDLE OR WINDOW ? **25;85273;TOOLONG &lt;p&gt;There are ( unspoken ) rules midair . The passenger on the aisle seat gets the legroom , the passenger in the middle gets most of the armrests , and the one by the window seats gets the luxury of leaning against the wall for an awkward , prisoner-like nap . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;So decide what would make you most at ease throughout the flight -- more leg room , support for your @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ . Bear in mind , the first two seats would also require you to move in case someone needs the toilet . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;On an ultra long-haul flight , the window seat might be your best option if you want to catch a few winks . Check in ahead of time to guarantee the seat of your choice . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;2 . THE BIG **30;85300;TOOLONG &lt;p&gt;Now that you have the best seat in the house , you need a good night&amp;#8217 ; s sleep . Sleep accessories could help you get a decent rest , ward off an aching neck and make wailing toddlers more bearable . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Pack ear plugs or noise-cancelling headphones to ensure you get some peace and quiet . They probably did their homework at school before they went home . They would read the textbook together . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Items necessary to maintain an appropriate classroom environment -- such as fuel , desks and chalk -- were also in short supply . Teachers required students to supply these materials , often favoring those who could bring more . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " padding-left : 30px ; " &gt;&amp;#8220 ; It was extremely cold @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ due to the chill weather . I had a hard time managing the cold . Those students who were unable to pay could not participate in educational activities . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " padding-left : 30px ; " &gt;&amp;#8220 ; The heating was done with coal or wood . We had to get wood but in elementary school we were too young to do the work , so we just paid for it . We burned those and left-over inedible parts of the corn -- burn that too . The seats were always fixed ; you had your spot . People who got the warm seats always sat there . Others who got the window seats did n't like it , so they skipped school . In middle school , we would take food and wood to school by hand wagon .... We would do that for days . If you could n't participate , @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ labor&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;&amp;#8220 ; The Socialist Labor Law of North Korea prohibits children under the age of 16 from working , &amp;#8221 ; the new report notes . However , these children constitute a large portion of the country 's labor force . In addition to integrating labor into the education system , children also work on public agricultural and construction projects . Students serve as an imperative supplementary workforce ; their labor was perceived as &amp;#8216 ; an extension of school work . &amp;#8217 ; Students were forced to work in the rice fields and on corn farms , performing a variety of tasks including weeding , picking up stones and harvesting . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Teachers often made children collect firewood and herbs , and also care for rabbits and other small animals to earn money for the operation of their schools . After the Arduous March , the Public Distribution System food rationing was discontinued in the marginalized northeastern regions of the country , including North Hamgyong province . Thus , students were often mobilized to generate profits for their teachers , who were also facing economic difficulties . &lt;/p&gt; @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ There was a farm where we planted cabbage and radishes , but we did n't get any products . Our teachers received rations from this farm . All students were mobilized to work in the farm . The work was quite intense . If you were working loosely , the teachers cursed us out . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the poorest regions of North Korea , some teachers did not receive any salary at all . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style= " padding-left : 30px ; " &gt;&amp;#8220 ; Students worked to help the farms , so the teachers got many sponsors from the farms . There was no monthly wage to the teachers . Teachers harvested corn based on the students ' labor , such as hanging corn and cleaning the places once or twice per week during the busy farming season . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The most common complaint , the report says , &amp;#8220 ; was the strenuous nature of the work , particularly during the summer months . Respondents also commonly described how the nature and intensity of their work assignments changed with the seasons as well as @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ padding-left : 30px ; " &gt;&amp;#8220 ; At school , we had classes in the morning and labored from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m . We were mobilized to assist farmers in the fields , to plant corn , and transplant rice seedlings with a hoe . In order to plaster walls , we were mobilized to dig mud and transport it by carrying a basin on our heads . We were put to work to the extent that we did n't die&amp;#8230 ; . We went to school for six days a week , from Monday to Saturday , and had Sunday off . No labor was assigned during exam weeks . In a typical week , we were forced to do three days of labor on average . In elementary school , students attended class in the morning and were mobilized to assist farmers in the fields in the afternoons . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;These interviews &amp;#8220 ; suggest widespread inequality in terms of school labor , which is similar to the inequality with respect to the submission of school supplies , &amp;#8221 ; the report says . @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ ; Those students who were better off offered bribes to teachers and were subsequently exempt from work assignments . Students could skip the labor activity only by paying the class or bribing the teacher&amp;#8230 ; . During long-term mobilization , the more affluent students accompanied their classmates to the farms , but were not required to work . So from 3:00 p.m. , we went to the farms and did farming activities until the sun set . We went to weed during the summer , we had a very hard time .... We also harvested corn in the fall . We also harvested rice in fall , but I did n't want to do it . So at our school , there was a music and art club and the rich kids would just learn music and art instead of being forced to work .... Poor kids could not join the club activities because they cost money , so they just went to the work sites . &amp;#8221 ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Students &amp;#8220 ; had to supply their own food during long-term mobilization . Financial Action Task Force ( FATF ) , which met recently in Paris , has decided to keep Pakistan on its &amp;#8216 ; grey list&amp;#8217 ; until February 2020. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The FATF monitors countries suspected of aiding terror attacks and imposes major financial constraints on them when they are found in violation of international laws . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Pakistan was put on the FATF &amp;#8216 ; grey list&amp;#8217 ; in June last year , which is one step short of the agency&amp;#8217 ; s &amp;#8216 ; black list&amp;#8217 ; . Once on the black list , a country faces severe economic sanctions . For a country like Pakistan @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ on the black list would cripple its economy . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;Final warning&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;The terror financing watchdog monitored the progress of 15 countries on its watch-list , including Pakistan , which was effectively given a final warning by the FATF to comply with its agreed proposal or risk being blacklisted in four months ' time . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Even though Pakistan avoided being relegated to the black list during the five-day summit last week , FATF President Xiangmin Liu was categorical in demanding that Islamabad must ' do more ' . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; " Despite a high-level commitment ... Pakistan has not made enough progress . If by February 2020 the country has not made significant progress , we will consider further actions which potentially could include placing the country ... on the blacklist , " Liu said . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Pakistan was formally placed on the grey list in June 2018 , when it was given 15 months to implement a 27-point action plan by the FATF , failing which Islamabad would be blacklisted. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Iran and North Korea are currently the only countries on the FATF blacklist. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;And with a @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ the counter-terror watchdog , diplomatic sources have said that Pakistan had its bases covered during the United Nations General Assembly ( UNGA ) meeting in New York last month . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; " Prime Minister Imran Khan had got support from both Turkey and Malaysia on both the Kashmir and FATF issues . The latest FATF warning is harsh , but we 're looking at it as an incentive to continue to make the improvements that we have made , " a senior Pakistani diplomat said . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;With Turkey and Malaysia voting for Pakistan , Islamabad knew that it only needed China 's vote to avoid the black list . They show that Trump 's approach to trade is not so much anti-establishment as it is opportunistic. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h4&gt;Tale of trade talks&lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;The deal with China , which that country has n't yet formally endorsed , &lt;a href= " https : **33;92897;TOOLONG ... to include&lt;/a&gt; a promise by Beijing to purchase up to $50 billion of additional US agricultural products and to revisit its foreign investment and intellectual property laws . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In return , the White House has suspended the imposition of its threatened tariff hikes , which had been due to take place on October 15. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Trump claims to have achieved more success with his aggressive stance during the 18-month trade war than prior presidents could boast when playing by the rules . It is ironic , then , that his trade sanctions against Europe @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ decade of work&lt;/a&gt; by previous administrations and stuck to the book . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The United States has long maintained that European countries subsidize Airbus , while the European Union has claimed that Washington uses defense spending to do the same for Boeing . The EU may soon get permission from the WTO to impose its own trade sanctions on US products if that case goes the way &lt;a href= " https : **33;92967;TOOLONG ... is expected to&lt;/a&gt;. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;figure class= " align-center " &gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;figure style= " width : 600px " class= " wp-caption alignnone " &gt;&lt;img src= " https : **34;93002;TOOLONG ... sizes= " ( min-width : 1466px ) 754px , ( max-width : 599px ) 100vw , ( min-width : 600px ) 600px , 237px " srcset= " https : **31;93038;TOOLONG ... 600w , https : **39;93071;TOOLONG ... 1200w , https : **39;93112;TOOLONG ... 1800w , https : **39;93153;TOOLONG ... 754w , https : **39;93194;TOOLONG ... 1508w , https : **39;93235;TOOLONG ... 2262w " alt= " " width= " 600 " height= " 400 " /&gt;&lt;figcaption class= " wp-caption-text " &gt;US President Donald Trump shakes hands with Chinese @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ **45;93276;TOOLONG ... &lt;h4&gt;'Forum shopping ' &lt;/h4&gt; &lt;p&gt;So why is the US following the rules in one case but flouting them in another ? Put simply , I believe Trump is " forum shopping . " &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Forum shopping is a term coined by &lt;a href= " https : **33;93323;TOOLONG ... relations theorists&lt;/a&gt; to explain why countries use varying international organizations , or none at all , to conclude similar deals . In all sorts of policy areas , &lt;a href= " https : **33;93358;TOOLONG ... theorists argue&lt;/a&gt; , states will choose to negotiate in forums that they believe will stack the odds in their favor . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;That 's why the US chose to work within the rules on Europe -- it knew they were on its side -- but beyond them in dealing with China . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the Europe dispute , the issue is quite definable : The EU 's Airbus subsidies &lt;a href= " https : **33;93393;TOOLONG ... a likely violation&lt;/a&gt; of global trade rules . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;For this reason , the administration has evidently concluded that the smart approach is to follow through with the legal @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ encompasses a wide range of issues -- from intellectual property theft to currency manipulation -- that would be difficult to adjudicate comprehensively . More to the point , the key Trump complaint -- the &lt;a href= " https : **33;93428;TOOLONG ... imbalance&lt;/a&gt; -- is not in itself even a violation of international trade law . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The legal route would have taken a long time and may well have gone nowhere . Given Trump 's political need to confront China , such an approach was too risky to consider . &lt;/p&gt; **33;93463;TOOLONG &lt;p&gt;But forum shopping has costs . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;When even the principal architect of the international trading rules -- the United States -- only appeals to those rules in search of its own interests , &lt;a href= " https : **33;93498;TOOLONG ... system 's legitimacy&lt;/a&gt; is eroded . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Why should Americans care ? &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;There is a reason that the development of an international trading system has been backed by Washington for seven decades -- it is extremely useful . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Having a level playing field in trade , based on clear rules , open information and non-discrimination @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ role&lt;/a&gt; in American , and global , economic growth . It has also encouraged interdependence and &lt;a href= " https : **33;93568;TOOLONG ... conflict&lt;/a&gt; . Chucking that system for a quick result as Trump has done in the case of China is a mistake . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Ultimately , for legal norms to function , I believe leading players like the US , China and the EU must all adopt a more enlightened , long-term view of their interests . They must be willing to recognize the authority of international rules even if they are tempted to ignore them in individual cases . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Let 's hope that future presidents will take a broader view and recognize America 's interests in a rule-based , cooperative international system , both in the trade arena and beyond . &lt;em&gt;&lt; ! -- End of code .
